title: Unread hub notices step from push to one email per thread to a daily digest, and stop once read

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/BqySUVMoZYsPcR49SBRUqB)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: each notice goes out on its own channels at once, so a busy Plan thread sends one email per comment and nothing respects quiet hours. Fix: a ladder (in-app at once, web push after 1 to 2 minutes if unseen, one email per thread after 15 to 30 minutes if unread, daily digest for the rest), cancelled on read; quiet hours in the person's time zone on notification preferences.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
